request: I want to swap USDC to USDT on CoW Swap. build me the template and its report

title.en: Place a CoW Swap sell order between USDC and USDT from the Safe
title.zh-TW: 從 Safe 在 CoW Swap 下一張 USDC 和 USDT 之間的賣單

summary.en: The Safe calls `setPreSignature` on CoW's settlement contract to pre-sign one sell order: exactly the card amount, for at least the card minimum, paid to the Safe. Needs an allowance to CoW's vault relayer first. Refuses buy, partial and fee orders.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 呼叫 CoW 結算合約的 `setPreSignature`，預先簽一張賣單：剛好賣出卡片上的數量、至少換到卡片上的最低值、付給 Safe。事先要有給 CoW vault relayer 的授權。買單、可部分成交和帶手續費的訂單都會被拒絕。

text.en: The order is bound to your amounts; solvers fill it later, and the order lives until it expires.
text.zh-TW: 訂單綁定你的數量；之後由 solver 成交，訂單在到期前都有效。

pastTxsConclusion.en: Misfits bundle an approval or a WETH wrap before the order, or are buy, partial or other-receiver orders; both directions of the pair fit, but the pre-signing calls move no token to trace.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 不符合的交易在訂單前多了授權或包 WETH，或是買單、可部分成交、收款人不是自己的訂單；這組代幣兩個方向都有符合的交易，但預簽本身不移動代幣，追蹤不到資金路徑。

intro.en: CoW Protocol: a trading protocol where users sign orders and solvers compete to settle them in batches through one settlement contract.
intro.zh-TW: CoW Protocol：使用者簽訂單，solver 競爭把訂單批次送進同一個結算合約成交的交易協定。

text.en: The settlement contracts were audited before launch (G0 Group, May 2021) and again in December 2021; both reports are in the contracts repository's audits folder. CoW's docs list GPv2Settlement and GPv2VaultRelayer as not upgradeable; only the solver allow-list is.
text.zh-TW: 結算合約上線前經過審計（G0 Group，2021 年 5 月），2021 年 12 月又審了一次；兩份報告都在合約 repo 的 audits 資料夾。CoW 文件寫明 GPv2Settlement 和 GPv2VaultRelayer 不可升級，只有 solver 白名單可以。

text.en: 7 February 2023: a newly allow-listed solver (Barter) had left an approval from the settlement contract to its SwapGuard contract, whose arbitrary call let an attacker take about 166,000 USD of fees the settlement contract held. No user order or allowance was touched; the approvals were revoked and the solver repaid the loss.
text.zh-TW: 2023 年 2 月 7 日：剛加入白名單的 solver（Barter）留下了結算合約對它 SwapGuard 合約的授權，攻擊者利用 SwapGuard 的任意呼叫，拿走結算合約裡約 16.6 萬美元的手續費。沒有動到使用者的訂單或授權；授權已撤銷，solver 已賠償。

text.en: Route: the CoW Swap Safe app pre-signs one order with `setPreSignature`. It adds an approval to the vault relayer in a MultiSend only when the allowance is short. Your Safe's USDC allowance to it was unlimited on 2026-11-27, so a USDC sell is this call alone.
text.zh-TW: 路徑：CoW Swap 的 Safe app 用 `setPreSignature` 預簽一張訂單；只有授權不夠時，才在 MultiSend 裡先加一筆給 vault relayer 的授權。你的 Safe 在 2026-11-27 對它的 USDC 授權是無上限，所以賣 USDC 只有這一個呼叫。

recommendation.en: Selling USDT needs a USDT approval first (none yet); a transaction with an approval gets MISMATCH: ask for that template then.
recommendation.zh-TW: 賣 USDT 要先授權 USDT（目前沒有）；帶授權的交易會得到 MISMATCH，那時再請 AI 做那個 template。

text.en: Your Safe keeps an unlimited USDC allowance to CoW's vault relayer. Only the settlement contract can make the relayer pull, and only for an order the Safe signed, within that order's amounts.
text.zh-TW: 你的 Safe 對 CoW vault relayer 一直保有無上限的 USDC 授權。只有結算合約能讓 relayer 扣款，而且只限 Safe 簽過的訂單、只在該訂單的數量內。

recommendation.en: If you stop using CoW, set that allowance back to 0 in a transaction of its own.
recommendation.zh-TW: 不再用 CoW 時，另外發一筆交易把這個授權設回 0。

text.en: After signing, the order stays fillable until its `validTo`, at most 12 hours after the block verify reads. A solver fills it once, at your minimum or better; until then the Safe can cancel it with `invalidateOrder`, or `setPreSignature` with false.
text.zh-TW: 簽完後，訂單在 `validTo` 前都可以成交，最多是 verify 讀的區塊之後 12 小時。solver 只會成交一次，價格不低於你的最低值；成交前 Safe 可以用 `invalidateOrder`，或以 false 呼叫 `setPreSignature` 取消。

recommendation.en: Check the order on the CoW explorer after execution; cancel it if you change your mind before it fills.
recommendation.zh-TW: 執行後到 CoW explorer 看訂單；成交前改變主意就取消它。

text.en: Who may settle is decided by CoW's solver allow-list, an upgradeable proxy 0x2c4c28DDBdAc9C5E7055b4C863b72eA0149D8aFE that CoW DAO controls; verify does not check its code. A solver can only fill your order within its signed amounts.
text.zh-TW: 誰能結算由 CoW 的 solver 白名單決定，它是 CoW DAO 控制、可升級的 proxy 0x2c4c28DDBdAc9C5E7055b4C863b72eA0149D8aFE；verify 不檢查它的程式碼。solver 只能在你簽的數量內成交你的訂單。

recommendation.en: Nothing to do per signing; know that CoW DAO picks the solvers.
recommendation.zh-TW: 每次簽名不用另外做什麼；知道 solver 是 CoW DAO 挑的就好。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.en: The order's id: its EIP-712 digest, its owner and its expiry, packed back to back. The settlement contract stores the pre-signature under this id and fills only the order that hashes to it.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.zh-TW: 訂單的 id：EIP-712 雜湊、擁有者、到期時間，依序緊接在一起。結算合約用這個 id 存預簽，只成交雜湊等於它的那張訂單。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.en: The hash of the whole order under CoW's domain. The transaction holds only this hash; verify reads the order from CoW's API and requires it to hash to exactly this value before it checks each member.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.zh-TW: 整張訂單在 CoW domain 下的雜湊。交易裡只有這個雜湊；verify 從 CoW 的 API 讀回訂單，算出的雜湊要完全相同，才逐項檢查。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.s.en: The token the order sells, the card's sell token.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.s.zh-TW: 訂單賣出的代幣，也就是卡片上的賣出代幣。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.b.en: The token the order buys, the card's buy token.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.b.zh-TW: 訂單買入的代幣，也就是卡片上的買入代幣。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.r.en: Who receives the bought tokens. It must be the Safe itself, written out; another address would let the swap pay someone else.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.r.zh-TW: 誰收到買到的代幣。必須明寫是 Safe 自己；換成別的地址，換到的錢就會付給別人。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.s.en: Exactly how much the order sells, the card's sell amount. A sell order never takes more than this.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.s.zh-TW: 訂單剛好賣出多少，就是卡片上的賣出數量。賣單不會拿走比這更多。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.b.en: The least the order may buy for the whole sell amount. The settlement contract refuses any fill below this limit price, so it holds when the order runs, not only at signing.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.b.zh-TW: 整個賣出數量至少要換到多少。結算合約拒絕任何低於這個限價的成交，所以它在訂單執行時仍然有效，不只是簽名時。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.v.en: When the order expires. The app sets about 30 minutes; the limit is 12 hours, above the longest other Safes used, so a slow multisig still fits, while an order valid for days or a year is refused.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.v.zh-TW: 訂單到期的時間。app 設約 30 分鐘；上限是 12 小時，高於其他 Safe 用過的最長值，讓簽得慢的多簽也能用，但有效好幾天或一年的訂單會被拒絕。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.a.en: The hash of the app's metadata for the order, such as its name and slippage. The contract does not read it; it cannot change the tokens, amounts or receiver.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.a.zh-TW: app 給這張訂單的資料（例如名稱、滑價）的雜湊。合約不讀它；它不能改變代幣、數量或收款人。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.f.en: A fee taken on top of the sell amount; it must be 0, as the app sends, so the Safe gives no more than the card's amount.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.f.zh-TW: 在賣出數量之外另收的手續費；必須是 0（app 就是這樣送），Safe 才不會付出超過卡片上的數量。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.k.en: The order kind: sell, so the sold amount is exact and the bought amount is at least the limit. A buy order is refused.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.k.zh-TW: 訂單種類：sell，賣出數量固定，買到的至少是限價。買單會被拒絕。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.p.en: false: the order fills once and whole, never in parts over time.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.p.zh-TW: false：訂單一次全部成交，不會分批慢慢成交。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.s.en: erc20: the sold tokens come from the Safe's own balance through its allowance to the vault relayer, not from a Balancer vault balance.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.s.zh-TW: erc20：賣出的代幣從 Safe 自己的餘額、經由給 vault relayer 的授權扣出，不是從 Balancer vault 的餘額。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.b.en: erc20: the bought tokens are paid as plain tokens to the receiver.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.orderDigest.b.zh-TW: erc20：買到的代幣以一般代幣付給收款人。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.owner.en: The order's owner, the Safe itself: only the owner can pre-sign its own order, and the settlement contract checks the caller is this owner.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.owner.zh-TW: 訂單的擁有者，就是 Safe 自己：只有擁有者能預簽自己的訂單，結算合約會檢查呼叫者就是它。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.validTo.en: The expiry again, as the id carries it; it must match the order's own. Same 12-hour limit, for the same reason.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.validTo.zh-TW: id 裡再帶一次的到期時間，必須和訂單自己的相同。同樣是 12 小時上限，理由相同。

1.setPreSignature.signed.en: true pre-signs the order; false would cancel an earlier pre-signature.
1.setPreSignature.signed.zh-TW: true 是預簽訂單；false 則是取消之前的預簽。
